authored_all_colliders.scope: all USD collision shapes including static surfaces

articulation.shape_path_mapping: backend shape order; no unverified path-order assumption

cartons.shape_path_mapping: backend shape order; no unverified path-order assumption

joint_telemetry_semantics.q_target: position-drive target sampled from the frozen trajectory clock
joint_telemetry_semantics.drive_input_effort: Isaac explicit effort-control input channel; not the realized position-drive output torque
joint_telemetry_semantics.external_joint_load_residual: UNAVAILABLE: projected reaction is not calibrated actuator torque

thresholds.source: ReplayQualificationPolicy and bound official joint limits; no debounce

collision_scope_complete.reason: robot self-collision and robot/payload scene contacts were monitored

premature_payload_conveyor_contacts_clea.reason: payload did not touch a conveyor before release

release_event_executed.reason: release event was outside the replayed interval

placement_within_tolerance.reason: placement cannot be evaluated because payload transport did not pass

gripper_limits_from_configuration.reason: vacuum force/break limits are outside the ideal-independent-cup mode

gripper_limits_calibrated.reason: no calibrated vacuum envelope is claimed in ideal-independent-cup mode

production_release_adapter.reason: release used a diagnostic state-handoff adapter

joint_positions_within_limits.reason: measured joint positions stayed inside the official limits

isaac_result.gripper_product_model: three-zone vacuum gripper with 72 FG42 cups

contact_report_semantics.legacy_contact_pairs: all reported proximity headers; POC acceptance uses measured pair separation and owned stage permissions
contact_report_semantics.physical_contact: finite separation <= bound existing support_max_gap_m; impulse is not an acceptance bypass
